name: harness-start
description: Harness Start plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: file-line-budget-guard
plugins.description: Ratchet-enforced file line budget guard: prevents source files from exceeding per-language line limits.

plugins.name: command-safety-guards
plugins.description: Command safety guards: deny broad recursive deletion, unbacked sed in-place edits, and cat heredoc writes outside temporary directories.

plugins.name: php-runtime-guards
plugins.description: PHP runtime guards: composer.json policy (repositories / unicode escapes / lockfile), protected generated paths, test output truncation, php -l and composer validate syntax, encoding, net-new debt and debug statements.

plugins.name: symfony-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Symfony runtime guards: protected generated paths (symfony.lock, var/cache, public/build, migrations), Doctrine entity mapping heuristics, Twig template syntax checks.

plugins.name: process-confidence
plugins.description: Observable delivery process: validated session begin, hook receipts, auto complete, Stop gate (hooks never auto-begin).

plugins.name: laravel-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Laravel hard guards: deny writes to generated paths (bootstrap/cache, storage/framework cache|views, storage/logs, public/build, existing database/migrations).

plugins.name: thinkphp-runtime-guards
plugins.description: ThinkPHP hard guards: deny writes to runtime directories (modern runtime/, legacy Application/Runtime/).

plugins.name: webman-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Webman hard guards: deny writes to the runtime directory (logs, pid files, caches).

plugins.name: typescript-runtime-guards
plugins.description: TypeScript/JS runtime guards: deny dependency lockfile writes; report encoding, net-new debt (any/as-any/suppressions), and syntax heuristics.

plugins.name: python-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Python runtime guards: deny poetry/pdm/pipenv/uv lockfile writes; report encoding, net-new debt (type:ignore/Any/bare except), and py_compile syntax.

plugins.name: go-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Go runtime guards: deny go.sum writes; report encoding, net-new debt (nolint/panic), and gofmt syntax issues.

plugins.name: rust-runtime-guards
plugins.description: Rust runtime guards: deny Cargo.lock writes; report encoding, net-new debt (allow/unwrap/todo!), and syntax heuristics.

plugins.name: jvm-runtime-guards
plugins.description: JVM runtime guards: deny gradle.lockfile writes; report encoding, net-new debt (SuppressWarnings/empty catch/Thread.sleep), and Java/Kotlin syntax heuristics.

plugins.name: web-frontend-guards
plugins.description: Frontend guards: report encoding, WXML/WXSS/Taro, mini-program configuration, Vue/Svelte, environment, and stylelint coverage issues.

plugins.name: infra-devops-guards
plugins.description: Infrastructure guards: deny irreversible data operations and unbounded probes; report syntax, encoding, debt, and recoverable operational risks.

plugins.name: mobile-guards
plugins.description: Mobile guards: deny generated lockfile writes; report Dart, Swift, and Objective-C issues; inject Android, Flutter, and Apple environment facts.
